next.reason: Exclusion kept: 'Neither data item contains an OCCURS, REDEFINES, or RENAMES clause or is of class index' (§2023:14.7.6 GR4) and 'Neither data item is subordinate to a group item that is subordinate to D1 or D2 when the group item contains an OCCURS or REDEFINES clause' (§2023:14.7.6 GR5); items under a USAGE INDEX group are themselves of class index. The ban on reference-modifying D1/D2 is kept: MOVE states it directly (§2023:14.9.25.3 SR12 'shall not be reference-modified'), and for ADD/SUBTRACT a reference-modified operand 'is considered to be an elementary data item' (§2023:8.4.3.3.4 GR6), so it fails the group-item requirement of §2023:14.9.2.3 SR6 and §2023:14.9.44.3 SR6. The added classes (message-tag, object, pointer) need features 1985 lacks.
